scope.claimBoundary: This is implementation preparation only. No denial operation or acceptance probe was run, and this artifact does not pass either AT or the whole R0.05 card.
scope.authorizedMutation: Only this nonsecret plan artifact was written.

sourceAssertions.assertion: Given _toy_agent, the OS denies write, unlink, rename, symlink replacement, chmod, and parent-directory replacement in control.
Given Johan has passwordless sudo, _toy_agent gains no privilege through sudo, su, privileged SSH, launchctl system mutation, or Johan's SSH agent; Johan's original access remains functional.

readbackBaseline.limit: This proves the R0.04 account/directory readback only; it does not prove any attempted OS denial or Johan-access preservation.

publicRoute.reuse: toy --env test --stack <owned-stack-id> probe run <AT-id> --case <fixed-case-id> --request-id <UUID> --json; inspect with probe show --json.
publicRoute.restrictions: The CLI accepts only the existing registered probe ID, a fixed case enum, request ID, and owned stack context. It accepts no UID, GID, path, executable, shell, argv, environment, expected outcome, or caller-authored case manifest. It never invokes sudo or elevates its caller.

ownerInterface.dispatch: Route only the two exact AT/case pairs from the existing registered-probe owner path; mismatched IDs/cases, production context, stale stack, missing identity readback, or absent protected manifest return blocked before staging or OS calls.
ownerInterface.cliChanges: Keep probe.run/show in cli/src/main.ts as the thin adapter. Add only fixed contract case IDs and owner dispatch; do not add a second CLI or system-poking script.

privatePipeContract.request: A generated @toy/contracts type carrying protocol version, requestId, exact AT ID, exact fixed case ID, and fixed case-manifest digest only.
privatePipeContract.response: A generated @toy/contracts type carrying child process identity, bounded per-operation outcome codes, canary pre/post metadata digests, child exit/signal, and artifact digests. Do not echo file contents, secret values, arbitrary stderr, or environment values.
privatePipeContract.child: One compiled TypeScript denial entry under the verified immutable tools closure, using Node built-ins and the private inherited pipe; it imports no protected Toy modules and runs no caller-selected code.

rootOwnedRuntimePaths.result: The owner validates and stores a sanitized result through the existing registered probe operation; the CLI exposes it through run/show and saves the nonsecret acceptance receipt under build/evidence/R0.05/.

actualIdentityExecution.parent: Require an already-root evaluator/owner process before staging root-only canaries. Resolve _toy_agent UID/GID from a fresh successful fixed identity readback, never CLI arguments. Verify the fixed child entry bytes/source digest against the immutable root-owned manifest before launch. Start only that absolute, sealed Node entry as root with fixed argv, private stdin/stdout pipes, a small byte cap, fixed environment, and bounded timeout. The CLI itself performs no privilege transition.
actualIdentityExecution.childIdentity: The sealed fixed child starts as root, calls process.initgroups('_toy_agent', measuredGid), then setgid(measuredGid), then setuid(measuredUid), before any denial attempt. It attests process.getuid/geteuid/getgid/getegid/getgroups against the verified dedicated role identity and exact expected group set; any mismatch exits blocked before attempts. Do not use Node spawn uid/gid options because they retain the parent's supplementary groups.
actualIdentityExecution.environment: Pass only fixed PATH, LANG, LC_ALL, and per-run scratch HOME/TMPDIR. Do not inherit, inspect, log, or forward Johan's environment, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, home, key files, agent responses, tokens, or provider credentials.
actualIdentityExecution.callerBoundary: Only the fixed compiled child, fixed case manifest, and verified numeric identity cross the protected root-to-child boundary. There is no arbitrary interpreter input or custom command.

protectedCaseRegistration.trigger: Only after fresh R0.04 identity receipt, exact root/control parent metadata, fixed immutable case-manifest digest, and unique disposable canaries are verified, run the six operations as actual _toy_agent.
faultControls: Real macOS process identity and filesystem permissions only; no simulated UID or fake OS adapter.
All six paths resolve inside a unique root-owned disposable canary directory under control; no production control file is enumerated or opened by the child.
observations: Each operation fails specifically with EACCES or EPERM; ENOENT, EEXIST, timeout, missing target, or generic child failure is not a denial pass.
Root independently verifies every canary's expected device/inode/owner/mode/content digest before and after, and verifies the canonical control directory metadata is unchanged.
The bounded child report, executable/case-manifest digests, actual child identity, CLI operation receipt, and exact cleanup readback are saved as nonsecret evidence.
protectedCaseRegistration.simUnavailableReason: SIM cannot attest the installed macOS service UID, real protected-directory metadata, or OS denial result; this assertion requires actual host/account evidence.

protectedCaseRegistration.trigger: Run only fixed noninteractive no-op privilege attempts under actual _toy_agent after checking the child identity; do not run any command that changes account, service, SSH, or launchd state.
faultControls: Each attempted command is fixed in the protected manifest, bounded, noninteractive, and has no caller-provided target or command text.

A launchctl case remains blocked until a non-destructive, collision-checked target and independent cleanup/readback are specified; do not bootstrap, unload, enable, disable, or mutate a real system job for this preparation.
observations: Every listed escalation route has a direct expected denial and no privileged effect receipt; a missing route is incomplete, not PASS.
Johan's original sudo and SSH access must have independent before/after functional evidence. The R0.04 identity readback is not this evidence.
No actual SSH_AUTH_SOCK, Johan home/environment, SSH agent response, private key, or secret is read or recorded. Sanitized child environment alone does not prove the real Johan SSH agent predicate.
protectedCaseRegistration.simUnavailableReason: SIM cannot prove actual macOS account separation, system privilege denial, or preservation of Johan's existing account access.

at35OperationDesign.preflight: The root parent lstat-checks /, /Library, /Library/Application Support, the canonical Toy root, and control against the fresh verified receipt; rejects symlinks, ownership/mode drift, writable ancestors, or any mismatch before creating a canary or attempting a denial.
at35OperationDesign.canaries: Create a UUID-named root-owned 0700 fixture directory under control with fixed harmless files, one fixed symlink, and one empty disposable directory. The child receives no arbitrary paths; it derives only these fixed names from the schema-validated request UUID.
sixAttempts: Write/truncate an existing harmless canary file.
Unlink an existing harmless canary file.
Rename an existing canary file to a fixed sibling destination.
Replace a pre-existing canary symlink by renaming a child-created harmless symlink from private scratch over it.
Chmod an existing harmless canary file.
Replace only a dedicated empty disposable parent-directory canary with a child-created empty directory; never rename/replace the canonical control directory or any directory containing real state.
at35OperationDesign.attribution: The root parent proves each target existed and was readable to root before the child runs, then checks the OS error code plus unchanged root-owned post-state. Missing-target or collision errors cannot count as permission denial.

cleanup.success: After the child exits and root verifies the expected fixture inode/device/owner and case result, remove only the exact UUID-named canary entries with nonrecursive unlink/rmdir operations; then reread the canonical control parent metadata and confirm the fixture path is absent.
cleanup.unexpectedMutation: If any denial operation succeeds, any inode/content differs unexpectedly, a path is a symlink, or the parent identity changes, stop the matrix, retain sanitized failure evidence, and do not recursively delete or repair an unverified path. Preserve the fixture for owner review.
cleanup.immutableRuntime: Keep the digest-bound root-owned Node/case-manifest bundle as part of the installed immutable tools closure; do not delete shared runtime files as probe cleanup.

acceptanceLimitations: AT-authority-35 cannot PASS from the R0.04 verify receipt alone, from stack bootstrap.fs-denial, from a simulated UID, or from a generic NOT_IMPLEMENTED fixture result.

AT-authority-36 is a whole-assertion acceptance row. Under the current no-SSH-environment-read boundary, the Johan SSH-agent and original-access predicates lack a qualifying safe evidence route; preserve them as BLOCKED until a nonsecret independently verifiable route exists. A sudo/su subset cannot be represented as AT-authority-36 PASS.

The protected assertion manifest/controller must bind both exact source hashes, all mandatory case IDs, child artifact digest, case-manifest digest, fixture identity, actual child identity, and independent pre/post readbacks. A --case selector is a diagnostic subset and cannot waive omitted mandatory cases.
Only these two bounded acceptance rows are prepared. Remaining R0.05 shell/MCP/GUI/CDP/Cua/bot-token/database-group/approval-signer assertions and AT-authority-37/69/73 remain outside this artifact.
